questions.question:
The mean of a distribution is 10 and the standard deviation is 5. What is the value of variance coefficient?

A. 50%

B. 100%

C. 150%

D. 200%
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The mean of a distribution is 10 and the standard deviation is 5.

**Formula used:**

Coefficient of variance = (Standard deviation/Mean) × 100

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

Standard deviation = 5 and Mean = 10

Coefficient of variance = (Standard deviation/Mean)× 100

⇒ (5/10)× 100

⇒ 50%

**∴ The value of variance coefficient is 50%.**

A. 6

B. 7

C. 8

D. 11
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The mean of 15 observations is 14.

Three more observations are included and the new mean becomes 13.

**Formula used:**

Mean = sum of observation/ number of observation

**Calculation:**

Mean of a 15 observation = 14

Sum of 15 observation = 15 × 14

⇒ 210

According to the question,

Three more observation is included, then Mean is 13

Let the new mean observation be x, y and z

⇒ (15 × 14) + x + y + z = (15 + 3)× 13

⇒ 210 + x + y + z = 234 

⇒ x + y + z = 234 – 210

⇒ x + y + z = 24

Mean = sum of observation/ number of observation

⇒ (x + y + z)/3

⇒ 24/3

⇒ 8.

**∴ The mean of three new observations is 8.**

questions.question:
Ritesh bought an old bike, the bike price increases by 50% after passing through three owners. If the first and second owners get 10% and 30% respectively, then find the % profit earned by the third owner.

A. 8%

B. 11%

C. 4.9%

D. 6.9%
questions.solution:
**Given**

Ritesh bought an old bike, the bike price increases by 50% after passing through three owners

The first and second owners get 10% and 30% respectively

**Formula used**

Profit% = (Profit / Cost Price) × 100

**Calculation**

Let initially CP of bike be Rs.x

⇒ After passing by there Price becomes x + x × 50 / 100

⇒ Price becomes 1.5x

⇒ Second person got the bike on x + x × 10 / 100

⇒ Price for Second person = 1.1x

⇒ Price for third person = 1.1x + 1.1x × 30 / 100

⇒ Price for third person = 1.43x

⇒ Profit earned by third person = 1.50x - 1.43x = 0.07x

⇒ Profit% = (0.07x / 1.43x) × 100

⇒ Profit% = 700 / 143 = 4 .9%

**∴ Profit earned by third person is 4.9%**

First person sell it to second person on Rs.110 

Second person gain 30% = 110 × 130 / 100

CP of bike for third person Rs.143

Profit gain by third person is 150 - 143 = Rs.7

Profit% = (7 / 143) × 100 = 4.9%

questions.question:
The length of the shadow of a pillar is reduced to 24 m, when the angle of elevation of the Sun increases from 30° to 60°, the length of the pillar is:

A. 10√3

B. 8√3

C. 16√3

D. 12√3
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The length of the shadow of a pillar is reduced to 24 m

The angle of elevation of the Sun increases from 30° to 60°

**Formula used:**

Tanθ = Perpendicular/Base

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fbdbdb88e3f99fb2b2fe796df7f57200473511ea2249a1098e708aeaa077bbd9.png] 

Let the height of pillar (AD) be h meter

And let the length of the shadow(BD) of be x meter

According to the question,

In Δ ACB,

tanθ = p/b

tan30° = h/(x + 24)

⇒ 1/√3 = h/(x + 24)

⇒ h = (x + 24)/√3 ----(1)

Again, 

n Δ ABD,

tanθ = p/b

tan60° = h/x 

⇒ √3 = h/x 

⇒ h = x√3 ----(2)

From equation (1) and equation (2):

⇒ (x + 24)/√3 = x√3

⇒ (x + 24) = 3x

⇒ (3x – x) = 24

⇒ 2x = 24

⇒ x = 12

Put the value of x = 12 in equation (2),

⇒ h = x√3

⇒ h = 12× √3 = 12√3

**∴ The height of pillar is 12√3 meter.**

The ratio of girls and boys among 504 students of a school is 11 : 13. If 12 more girls are given admission, the new ratio will be:

A. 3 : 51

B. 9 : 8

C. 81 : 91

Total boys and girls = 504

Ratio of boys and girls = 13 : 11

And girls be 11x

According to the question:

11x + 13x = 504 

⇒ 24x = 504

⇒ x = 504/24 = 21

Girls = 11x = 11 × 21 = 231

Boys = 13x = 13 × 21 = 273

Again,

12 more girls are admitted = 12 + 231 = 243

New ratio = 273 : 243

⇒ Boys : Girls = 91 : 81

**∴ The ratio of Girls and Boys are 81 : 91.**
